title: Final Probabilities
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expressions for P(+) and P(-).

title: Hamiltonian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the Hamiltonian for the system based on the magnetic moment and magnetic field.

title: Schrodinger Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the Schrodinger equation for the spin wave function accurately.

title: Time Evolution
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the correct time evolution of the spin states a1(t) and a2(t).

title: Normalization Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student may check that the probabilities sum to 1, confirming normalization of the wave function.

title: Correct Units
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid unit mistakes, particularly in the expressions for angular frequency omega.

title: Common Algebra Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be cautious of sign mistakes or algebraic errors when calculating probabilities.
